notes: Accounting standard: all figures are IFRS as issued by the IASB. Infineon's primary accounting standard was US GAAP up to FY2008 and IFRS from 1 October 2008 (stated in the FY2009 Form 20-F); the FY2007 and FY2008 figures here are the IFRS figures presented retrospectively in that filing, not the originally published US GAAP numbers.

FY2007–FY2009 are restated to exclude the DRAM business Qimonda (deconsolidated February 2009) and the Wireline Communications business (sold to Lantiq, closed November 2009). Originally reported FY2007 revenue was EUR 7,679m including Qimonda; the restated continuing-operations figure is EUR 3,660m.

FY2009 is also restated to exclude the Wireless Solutions (baseband) business sold to Intel in Q1 FY2011: revenue was EUR 3,027m in the FY2009 Form 20-F and EUR 2,184m in the later tables (Annual Report 2010 onwards). The later figure is used (restated: true).

Because of that reclassification, FY2008 (which still includes Wireless Solutions) is not directly comparable with FY2009 onwards; no Infineon document found publishes FY2008 excluding Wireless Solutions.

netIncome and totalEquity are attributable to the shareholders of Infineon Technologies AG. For FY2007–FY2009 the group totals included non-controlling interests (FY2009: group net loss EUR 671m per the 20-F, of which EUR 623m attributable; restated group net loss EUR 674m in Annual Report 2011/2012, attributable amount not published there).

operatingIncome is the IFRS "operating profit / operating income" line of the consolidated income statement (it differs from the EBIT-from-continuing-operations figure the company also publishes, e.g. EUR 1,515m vs EUR 1,536m in FY2025).

operatingCashFlow is "net cash provided by operating activities from continuing operations" as printed in the company's tables, so FY2007–FY2011 exclude the discontinued businesses (e.g. FY2011 total operating cash flow was EUR 2,189m including EUR 1,206m from discontinued operations).

capex: from FY2010 the company's line "purchases of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets and other assets" (its free-cash-flow definition); for FY2007–FY2009 intangibles were reported on a separate line, so only purchases of property, plant and equipment (EUR 492m, 308m, 103m) are included. Stored negative.

totalDebt is the company's "Debt" / "Financial debt" line. For FY2007 and FY2008 no single total is published; the figure is the sum of the two published lines (short-term debt and current maturities EUR 336m/207m plus long-term debt EUR 1,227m/963m), which reproduces exactly the EUR 850m "Debt" the company itself reports for FY2009.

cashAndEquivalents is the balance-sheet line "cash and cash equivalents" (end of period). It is much lower than the company's "gross cash position", which also counts current securities (EUR 2,102m at 30 September 2025).

sharesOutstanding: FY2007 and FY2008 are shares issued at 30 September from the consolidated statement of changes in equity; FY2009–FY2012 are "shares outstanding" in the company tables; FY2013 onwards the company reports "shares issued" (treasury shares are not deducted).

dividendPerShare: zero for FY2007–FY2009. FY2009 is shown as "–" in the company tables and no dividend distribution appears in the FY2009 Form 20-F statement of changes in equity for FY2007 or FY2008 either; the first dividend in the company history was the EUR 0.10 proposed for FY2010. The FY2025 figure (EUR 0.35) is the dividend proposed to the 2026 Annual General Meeting.

employees: FY2007 and FY2008 are Infineon employees excluding Qimonda (29,598 and 29,119); the group total including Qimonda was 43,079 and 41,343. FY2009 onwards are group totals on the continuing-operations basis.

Cross-check against docs/global-companies/snapshot-2026-10-26.json (USD): for FY2022–FY2025 the snapshot revenue and net income are both exactly 1.0705x / 1.0797x / 1.0872x / 1.1065x the EUR figures here, i.e. the deviations come only from the EUR/USD rate used there, not from a different line, scope or unit.
